blog_1.title: The Art of Scandinavian Minimalist Layouts
blog_1.excerpt: Light colours, honest materials and fewer things. How to bring the Scandinavian look into your room.
blog_1.p1: Scandinavian design is about calm. Light walls, natural wood, soft fabrics and only the furniture you really use. It works in a big living room and in a small bedroom.
blog_1.p2: Pick two or three soft colours, such as white, warm grey and sand. Keep the large pieces, like the sofa and rug, in these shades. Then add one or two natural materials, for example oak or walnut.
blog_1.p3: Minimalist does not mean empty, but it does mean room to breathe. Leave some wall and floor free, and choose one strong piece for each corner instead of many small ones.
ul1: Choose furniture with clean lines and slim legs.
Use texture (boucle, wool, linen) instead of pattern.
Keep surfaces clear. Store small things out of sight.
Add one lamp with a warm bulb to every seating area.

blog_2.title: Choosing the Right Timber: Walnut vs Oak
blog_2.excerpt: Both are beautiful and long lasting. Here is how they differ in colour, strength and care.
blog_2.p1: Walnut and oak are two of the most loved woods for furniture. Both last for many years, but they look and feel different, so the right choice depends on your room and your taste.
blog_2.p2: Walnut is dark and rich, from chocolate brown to deep purple-brown. It makes a bed or a table feel warm and serious. Oak is lighter, with a clear and visible grain, and suits bright, airy rooms.
blog_2.p3: Oak is a little harder, so it handles dents and daily use very well. Walnut is slightly softer but still strong, and it is easy to work, which is why it is often used for detailed joinery.
ul1: Small or dark room: oak, because it reflects more light.
Large bedroom or study: walnut, for a calm and rich feeling.
Busy family dining table: oak, for extra resistance to wear.
Mixing both is fine. Keep one wood as the main one and use the other as an accent.

blog_3.title: Lighting Principles for Contemporary Open Spaces
blog_3.excerpt: One ceiling light is never enough. Layer your lighting to make an open room feel warm.
blog_3.p1: In an open room, one bright ceiling light makes everything look flat. Good rooms use several sources of light at different heights.
ul1: General light: the main light that fills the room.
Task light: a reading lamp or desk lamp where you need to see clearly.
Accent light: a soft lamp that highlights a corner, shelf or artwork.
blog_3.p2: Warm white bulbs make wood and fabric look softer. Cool white is better for kitchens and work areas.
blog_3.p3: A large mirror placed across from a window brings daylight deeper into the room.

blog_4.title: Maximizing Compact Apartment Floor Plans
blog_4.excerpt: Smart furniture choices that give you more room to live in a small apartment.
blog_4.p1: A small apartment can feel open and comfortable if every piece has a job. The goal is to use walls and corners well, and to keep the floor as clear as possible.
blog_4.p2: Wall shelves and floating units free the floor and make the room look larger. Keep the lower part of the wall for things you use every day.
blog_4.h2: Choose pieces that do two things
ul1: A side table that also holds a lamp and your books.
A desk that can be raised for standing and lowered for sitting.
A TV unit with closed storage for cables and games.
blog_4.p3: Before you order, measure the room, the door and the stairs. Leave at least 80 cm of walking space in the main paths of the room.

blog_5.title: Sustainable Materials in Luxury Home Decor
blog_5.excerpt: What to look for when you want furniture that is kinder to the environment and lasts longer.
blog_5.p1: The most sustainable furniture is the piece you keep for twenty years. Good materials and strong construction matter more than any label.
ul1: Solid wood from responsibly managed sources.
Natural fibres such as wool, linen and cotton.
Joinery that can be repaired, not glued once and thrown away.
blog_5.p2: Dust wood with a soft dry cloth, wipe spills at once, and keep wood and leather away from direct sun and heaters. Small habits keep furniture beautiful for years.

about.title: About Lumina Home
about.subtitle: Calm, well-made furniture for the way you live.

story.title: Our story
story.p1: Lumina Home started with a simple idea: good furniture should feel warm, look timeless and be honest about how it is made.
story.p2: Our designers and craftsmen work together on every piece, from the first sketch to the final finish. We choose materials with care and test each design for comfort and strength before it reaches you.
story.p3: We deliver and set up the furniture ourselves, so it arrives in your home the way it should.

honest.title: Honest materials
honest.text: Solid wood, real leather and quality fabrics. We tell you exactly what each piece is made of.

durable.title: Built to last
durable.text: Strong joinery and careful finishing, so your furniture stays good for years, not seasons.

care.title: Looked after
care.text: From the first message to set-up in your home, a real person from our team is with you.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.intro: Quick answers about orders, delivery, returns and care.
faq.more_text: Read our <shipping>Shipping & Returns</shipping> page or <contact>contact us</contact>. We reply within one working day.

place_order.title: How do I place an order?
place_order.content: Add the items you like to your cart, go to checkout, enter your delivery address and choose a payment method. You will get a confirmation email once the order is placed.

payment.title: Which payment methods do you accept?
payment.content: You can pay by cash on delivery, by card or by bank transfer. The available options are shown at checkout.

change_cancel.title: Can I change or cancel my order?
change_cancel.content: Yes, before it is dispatched. Email or call us with your order number as soon as possible. Made-to-order pieces cannot be cancelled once production has started.

how_long.title: How long does delivery take?
how_long.content: Most orders arrive in 3 to 8 working days, depending on your city. Made-to-order pieces take 2 to 3 weeks. The estimated time is shown on each product page.

assembly.title: Do you assemble the furniture for me?
assembly.content: Yes. Our delivery team brings the furniture inside and sets it up where you want it, at no extra charge.

tracking.title: How can I track my order?
tracking.content: We send tracking details by email and SMS once your order is dispatched. You can also call us with your order number for an update.

return_policy.title: What is your return policy?
return_policy.content: You can return unused items in their original packaging within {{days}} days of delivery. Made-to-order and final-sale items cannot be returned.

damaged.title: What if my furniture arrives damaged?
damaged.content: Contact us within 48 hours of delivery with your order number and photos. We will repair it, replace it or refund you, and we pay for the pickup.

warranty.title: Is there a warranty?
warranty.content: Our furniture comes with a 1-year warranty against manufacturing defects. It does not cover normal wear, misuse or damage from moisture and sunlight.

colour.title: Will the colour match the photos?
colour.content: We try to show colours as accurately as possible, but screens differ slightly. If you want to be sure, contact us and we will send extra photos of the piece.

care.title: How do I clean and care for my furniture?
care.content: Dust wood with a soft dry cloth and wipe spills right away. Keep wood and leather away from direct sunlight and heaters. Fabric pieces can be vacuumed gently every week.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: At <brand>{{name}}</brand>, we respect your privacy and are committed to protecting your personal data. This privacy policy explains how we look after your personal data when you visit our boutique furniture store and tells you about your privacy rights.

s1.title: 1. Information We Collect
s1.intro: We may collect, use, store and transfer different kinds of personal data about you which we have grouped together as follows:
s1.identity_text: Includes first name, last name, and username.
s1.contact_text: Includes billing address, delivery address, email address, and telephone numbers.
s1.transaction_text: Includes details about payments to and from you and other details of products you have purchased from us.

s2.title: 2. How We Use Your Data
s2.intro: We will only use your personal data when the law allows us to. Most commonly, we will use your personal data in the following circumstances:
s2.item1: To register you as a new customer.
s2.item2: To process and deliver your furniture orders including managing payments, fees, and charges.
s2.item3: To manage our relationship with you which will include notifying you about changes to our terms or privacy policy.

s3.title: 3. Data Security
s3.text: We have put in place appropriate security measures to prevent your personal data from being accidentally lost, used or accessed in an unauthorized way, altered or disclosed. In addition, we limit access to your personal data to those employees, agents, contractors and other third parties who have a business need to know.

s4.title: 4. Contact Us
s4.text: If you have any questions about this privacy policy or our privacy practices, please contact our support desk:
